newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Mandela invites Mobutu to meet Kabila in S.Africa.
newsitem.headline: Mandela invites Mobutu to meet Kabila in S.Africa.

text.p: President Nelson Mandela has extended a formal invitation to Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko to visit South Africa for talks with rebel leader Laurent Kabila, officials said on Thursday.
"The president has extended a formal invitation to President Mobutu ... for a meeting with Laurent Kabila," deputy foreign affairs minister Aziz Pahad told a news conference.
The invitation was being conveyed on Thursday to Mobutu by his envoy Honore Ngbanda, who was returning home after having talks with Mandela on Wednesday, Pahad said.
South Africa hoped Mobutu would take up the invitation soon.
Rebel leader Kabila also returned to Zaire on Thursday from Cape Town after talks in South Africa with Mandela about the war aimed at unseating Mobutu.
Mandela earlier told reporters he had spoken to Mobutu three times since last Saturday and that the troubled president had been "very co-operative".
